title: Partial and blocked outcomes use honest status vocabulary
summary: Outcome reports distinguish restored function from an established fix, partial from complete coverage, and blocked with a named cause and owner; no outcome is rounded up to success.

protected.asset: The owner's ability to schedule downstream work on the real state of prior work
protected.failure: A repaired-but-unexplained function is reported as fixed, or a blocked task as done, and downstream work is scheduled on a false foundation.

rationale: 'Function is currently restored; the cause is open' is an acceptable report; 'the cause is eliminated' requires the causal chain: the original failure, the hypothesis or change, a regression check, and data from a nominal run. A blocked item names the precise missing input or decision and who owns it, instead of a generic failure. Partial coverage states the examined fraction. Rounding any of these up to success converts an open question into invisible risk that later work inherits.

variants.description: Every outcome report uses a fixed vocabulary: verified, exercised, implemented, restored-cause-open, blocked-with-named-cause; the wording is chosen by the strongest available evidence class.
Each success claim names the evidence that supports it; when evidence is missing, the claim is downgraded, never reworded to sound stronger.

verification.method: Review one completed and one interrupted work item; confirm the reported wording matches the strongest available evidence class and that the blocked item names its cause and owner.
verification.evidence: The two reports with their evidence classes; private content stays out of the record.

rollback.method: Drop the vocabulary requirement; reports remain readable but lose the evidence grading.
rollback.safety: The vocabulary constrains reporting only; it never blocks the underlying work.

failure_modes: A single successful retry closes a repair whose scheduler-level cause was never found.
An exit code of zero is treated as functional proof of the feature.
A blocked item is silently dropped from the report instead of carried with its named cause.

hermes_versions.notes: Operational practice control: applies to any reporting surface; the range records the builds whose reporting conventions the vocabulary was read against.

last_verification.notes: General operational synthesis from recorded practice with private detail removed; no specific public incident is claimed.

references: General operational synthesis from recorded practice; no publicly verifiable incident is cited.
